DRAG DROP -
Refer to the exhibit. An administrator must complete the unified fabric configuration between Server1 and a pair of Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switches. Drag and drop the code snippets from the right onto the blanks in the code on the left to complete the N9K-1 configuration. Code snippets may be used more than once.
context: Topology: SAN-A (vsan 100) and LAN (vlan 100) and SAN-B (vsan 200) connect to N9K-1 and N9K-2 (FCF) via e1/9. N9K-1 and N9K-2 connect via 802.3ad Po12 to Server1.
imageNote: Diagram: SAN-A (vsan 100), LAN (vlan 100), and SAN-B (vsan 200) clouds connect to N9K-1 and N9K-2 (both FCF, e1/9), which are linked to each other and to Server1 via an 802.3ad port channel Po12.
